text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Cheva-chi...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Cheva-chiii! I'm gonna 
catch you this time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-Again...? It's been non-stop since this 
morning... I-I'm busy right now, so...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! Aahh~! Wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Jeez, it ran away again...

Since morning, Vivlos has been following 
Cheval Grand around nonstop. Naturally 
curious, I decide to ask her the reason 
why.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because you appeared in my dream, 
Cheva-chi!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ They patted my head just like when 
I was a kid~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm just in the mood to get pampered 
by Cheval-chi☆

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Still, she runs away so quickly... Hey, 
what can I do so she'll pet me like she 
used to?"
choice_data_list: Hmm, our only option is to ask...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right? There's really no other way, is 
there? All right... Cheval-chi, I'm coming 
to catch ya~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's a pebble by my feet. I'm 
gonna fall~! Help me~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Are you alr—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: You didn't even fall...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait up—!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I've got delicious meat buns right here, 
you know~ I even prepared a full course of 
Chinese cuisine, too~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *glance*

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not falling for that...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aah!!

Even after that, they tried everything to 
catch Cheval Grand, but with little 
success...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Uuu... Cheval-chi, you're tough to beat...

Exhausted, Vivlos collapsed limply and 
fell asleep right where she was.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. Seriously, what is all this 
about...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Falling asleep in a place like this... 
What're you gonna do if you catch a cold?"

Cheval Grand gently touches Vivlos's hair. 
Without any particular thought, she simply 
strokes her head while listening to her 
peaceful breathing.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(...Cheval-chi is patting my head... Wow, 
waah...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Fast asleep... Looks like they won't be 
waking up anytime soon.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I'll walk a bit further away and 
ring their phone."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Ehehehehe...

Overjoyed by being patted on the head, 
Vivlos couldn't stop smiling.

Exhausted, Vivlos collapsed limply and 
fell asleep right where she was.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Falling asleep in a place like this... 
What're you gonna do if you catch a cold?"

Cheval Grand gently touches Vivlos's hair. 
Without any particular thought, she simply 
strokes her head while listening to her 
peaceful breathing.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Cheval-chi... Ehe... Ehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. Good grief... What on earth are 
you dreaming about...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: There, there. Good girl, good girl.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"This time, a biiiig squeeze! Hug me, 
Cheval-chi!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Let me pamper myself... lots and 
looots♡

Exhausted, Vivlos collapsed limply and 
fell asleep right where she was.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Falling asleep in a place like this... 
What if you catch a cold—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Caught you, Cheva-chi~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? P-Pretending to be asleep... That's 
playing dirty!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm not pretending to sleep! I literally 
just woke up!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Brace yourself. I'm not letting you 
get away anymore♡
